knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 有效率 R=N有效/ΣΔt有效；剔除事件時必須同步剔除曝光。
knowledge.textEn: Valid rate R=N_valid/ΣΔt_valid;event filtering requires matching exposure filtering.

quiz.question: 「事件與好時間」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Events and good-time intervals: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: R=(20+25+35)/(3×100)=0.266667 counts/s；未篩選平均 0.7 不代表較高可靠源通量。
交付好時間區間、事件數、曝光及門檻敏感度，不只一張清理後圖。
只刪高計數但保留全曝光會低估率；只依源亮度篩選也可能刪除真正天體爆發。
optionsEn: R=80/300=0.266667 counts/s;unfiltered mean 0.7 is not a more reliable source flux.
Deliver good-time intervals,counts,exposure and cut sensitivity,not only a cleaned image.
Removing counts but retaining all exposure biases rate low;screening on source brightness can remove real flares.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。只刪高計數但保留全曝光會低估率；只依源亮度篩選也可能刪除真正天體爆發。 與本階段判準一起判讀：拒收理由來自背景而非想得到的源率。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Removing counts but retaining all exposure biases rate low;screening on source brightness can remove real flares. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Rejection follows background evidence,not a desired source rate.

steps.title: 事件與好時間 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Events and good-time intervals · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「事件與好時間」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Events and good-time intervals and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
只刪高計數但保留全曝光會低估率；只依源亮度篩選也可能刪除真正天體爆發。
對照「事件與好時間」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。篩選規則由獨立背景通道設定，對源事件與曝光一致套用。
本階段必須重驗：拒收理由來自背景而非想得到的源率。
steps.instructionEn:
Removing counts but retaining all exposure biases rate low;screening on source brightness can remove real flares.
Against the nominal Events and good-time intervals result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Set cuts from an independent background channel and apply them consistently to source events and exposure.
Reverify this criterion: Rejection follows background evidence,not a desired source rate.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。只刪高計數但保留全曝光會低估率；只依源亮度篩選也可能刪除真正天體爆發。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Removing counts but retaining all exposure biases rate low;screening on source brightness can remove real flares.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 拒收理由來自背景而非想得到的源率。
steps.checkEn: Rejection follows background evidence,not a desired source rate.

quiz.question: 「事件與好時間」：哪一項提供依證據採取處置或重新驗證的條件？
quiz.questionEn: Events and good-time intervals: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 有效率 R=N有效/ΣΔt有效；剔除事件時必須同步剔除曝光。
篩選規則由獨立背景通道設定，對源事件與曝光一致套用。
XMM-Newton 結合 X 射線與光學紫外線觀測，可做長時間天體觀測。
optionsEn: Valid rate R=N_valid/ΣΔt_valid;event filtering requires matching exposure filtering.
Set cuts from an independent background channel and apply them consistently to source events and exposure.
XMM-Newton combines X-ray and optical/ultraviolet observations for extended exposures.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。篩選規則由獨立背景通道設定，對源事件與曝光一致套用。 與本階段判準一起判讀：拒收理由來自背景而非想得到的源率。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Set cuts from an independent background channel and apply them consistently to source events and exposure. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Rejection follows background evidence,not a desired source rate.

steps.title: 事件與好時間 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Events and good-time intervals · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「事件與好時間」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Events and good-time intervals and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付好時間區間、事件數、曝光及門檻敏感度，不只一張清理後圖。
在交接件中加入「事件與好時間」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：拒收理由來自背景而非想得到的源率。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：從高背景時段剔除不適用資料，計算好時間區間與有效計數率。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver good-time intervals,counts,exposure and cut sensitivity,not only a cleaned image.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Events and good-time intervals: Rejection follows background evidence,not a desired source rate.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Remove unsuitable high-background intervals and calculate good-time exposure and count rate. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。拒收理由來自背景而非想得到的源率。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Rejection follows background evidence,not a desired source rate.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 拒收理由來自背景而非想得到的源率。
steps.checkEn: Rejection follows background evidence,not a desired source rate.
